The full pipeline also consumes separate prepared inputs whose producer, product, or schema is not supplied: an extra facility/borrower match table, the Compustat panel assembly, lender/covenant counts, monthly rating, conservatism coefficient, underwriting tables, and hedge-fund/underwriter auxiliary tables.

actions.description: Stage the four readable local DealScan products with their supported native fields and the code's existing joins, role filters, and allocation operations.
steps: Import each native product into the working copy while retaining its native identifiers and required columns.
Map the native field case/format into the supplied Stata variable references and keep the Facility, Package, LenderShares, and CurrFacPricing tables as separate sources.
Apply the code's authored facility/package merges, USA and 1995+ sample filters, lender-role definitions, lender-share aggregation, and pricing deduplication in their supplied order.
validation: Confirm the staged fields and FacilityID/PackageID/CompanyID mappings match the source contracts.
During the future full run, validate ordinary sample-year and join coverage for the authored USA/1995+ sample and 36-month reputation construction without imposing new endpoints.
Confirm each product is staged through its own source edge and that the authored output variables retain their units and labels.

actions.description: Identify the separate facility/borrower match input used after the Facility read.
steps: Obtain the P0004 input's product, population purpose, exact field list, identifier types, and the author-prepared file or documented producer.
Keep this table distinct from the Facility product until the author source relationship is established.
validation: Confirm facilityid and borrowercompanyid types/key coverage and the supplied m:1 match after staging.

actions.description: Resolve the prepared quarterly Compustat input's field ownership and component assembly.
steps: Obtain the author-prepared quarterly file and its schema, or the supplied construction steps that assemble ni/at and sic with the quarterly fundamentals.
Keep quarterly atq/niq and the other quarterly fields on their documented quarterly contract; do not substitute annual FUNDA values for them.
Confirm how gvkey, datadate, sic, cik, and cusip enter the prepared panel before deriving yq and the facility merge.
validation: Validate the input's required columns against the source list, then confirm the existing gvkey/yq merge after author preparation.
During a future full run, check actual consumed sample-period coverage under the authored datadate>=1994 filter.

actions.description: Obtain the prepared facility-level lender count and its source definition.
steps: Request num_lender.dta or its author-documented producer, including the facility key, count unit, and any filtering or lender-correction rules.
Keep the separate count contract until the author supplies its construction; the readable lender-share source does not specify that prepared count by itself.
validation: Check facilityid and num_lender fields and apply the supplied one-to-one merge and the authored minimum-two-lender filter.

actions.description: Resolve the prepared facility-level covenant count table and the definitions used by the analysis.
steps: Request the prepared facility-level count input or its author-supplied producer and definitions for financialcovenant_count, tightcov_count, num_incomecov, and num_bscov.
Clarify how the package-level raw covenant candidate maps to the facility-level counts if it is part of the author's documented construction.
validation: Verify the facility key, count definitions, and all four consumed fields before applying the one-to-one merge.

actions.description: Obtain the issuer-quality table with the code's monthly gvkey/ym/spcsrc contract.
steps: Request the actual monthly prepared input or its documented construction, including the gvkey and ym key and the historical spcsrc meaning.
Keep current COMP.COMPANY ranking separate from the monthly rating input.
validation: Confirm the monthly key and rating fields and future merge coverage for the facility year-months retained by the code.

actions.description: Stage the compatible annual S&P rating component from local COMP.ADSPRATE.
steps: Stage gvkey, datadate, and splticrm from the readable ADSPRATE product into the annual issuer input.
Map datadate to calendar year for the supplied gvkey-year merge, preserving splticrm and its issuer-rating meaning.
validation: Confirm the existing m:1 gvkey-year merge for the prepared input and ordinary coverage of the facility years used; request a within-year rule only if a real duplicate-key condition remains after the source's existing preparation.

actions.description: Identify the source and calculation that produce _b_loss_return for the annual issuer input.
steps: Request the author-prepared coefficient field or its exact producer, including its measure definition, issuer/year keys, and merge into the annual issuer input.
Keep the rating component and coefficient component distinct until the supplied producer establishes their relationship.
validation: Verify the coefficient's source fields and gvkey/year coverage before applying the authored high_conserve and winsorization operations.

actions.description: Identify the four separately consumed underwriting tables and their schemas.
steps: For P0016 through P0019, obtain each author-prepared file or its producer separately.
Confirm facilityid joins, lead/nonlead/nonlender definitions, required equity/bond/IPO-lender fields, and the allocation fields and percentage units.
validation: Validate each table's own facility key and field contract before its one-to-one merge; preserve the four distinct table roles.

actions.description: Resolve the three distinct facility-keyed hedge-fund/auxiliary inputs and map their consumed fields.
steps: Obtain the P0020 input's product and have_hf_nonlead field definition.
For P0021 and P0022, identify which file supplies all and which supplies total_hf_holding, together with their definitions, units, and facility key.
validation: Verify each table and its actual consumed fields separately before the three facility-level merges.

actions.description: Obtain the facility-level underwriting-lender count table and its counting rule.
steps: Request the P0023 prepared input or producer, defining num_underwriting_lender and its facility-level counting unit.
validation: Confirm the facilityid and num_underwriting_lender fields and the input expected by the existing fraction calculation with num_lender.

actions.description: Resolve all remaining prepared-table and producer contracts named by their input-specific actions before treating the supplied workflow as closed.
steps: Collect the author-prepared inputs and source/field specifications requested by the linked requirements.
Keep independent facility merges separate and retain the specific Compustat frequency, covenant grain, rating period, count-definition, and hedge-fund field-mapping gaps until supported.
validation: Reconcile every active source read and the missing include against the selected full_pipeline requirements, then update closure only when each branch has a compatible route or a supplied producer.

Preserve the ordered reputation chain: temp/facility_ym.dta, temp/insample_leadlender.dta and temp/insample_lead_nonleadpair.dta, temp/set_insample_leadloans.dta, temp/reputation.dta and temp/insample_lead_past36total.dta, then combined_reputation.dta.
Continue through the underwriting, covenant, Compustat, rating, hedge-fund, and other facility inputs; retain merge_sample.dta and the supplied lead_mktshare_facility.dta output.
After the merge program saves regression_sample.dta, run Regression_JAR_2025.do from the same configured working directory.
validation: Confirm each documented producer completes before its consumer, including merge_sample.dta before line 781 and regression_sample.dta before the regression entry read.
Confirm the final dataset contains the variables referenced by the regression code and that outreg2 writes the authored table target.
Record software and data versions/coverage from the future run without treating this static assessment as execution verification.

review_notes: The target is the complete supplied merge and regression workflow. No analysis_only route is supported because regression_sample.dta is produced by the merge program and is absent from the package inventory.
The datasheet title matches the frozen package title in substance; its workflow documentation names WRDS and merge_JAR_2025.do. Frozen title and DOI metadata remain unchanged.

The local DealScan Facility, Package, LenderShares, and CurrFacPricing products are positively verified for their required raw products, fields, identifiers, and meanings using direct readable probes. Remaining import, formatting, merge, and ordinary sample-coverage checks are preparation steps.

The quarterly Compustat contract remains unresolved at ni/at/sic ownership and panel assembly. FUNDQ is quarterly; FUNDA supplies annual ni/at and COMPANY has sic. The assessment does not switch frequency or infer an unprovided join.

ADSPRATE is credited for the issuer-rating field with datadate mapped to calendar year. The distinct _b_loss_return producer, monthly spcsrc input, facility counts, underwriting tables, hedge-fund field ownership, and separate facility link remain specific prepared-input questions.

The two commented-out lending-relationship and distance blocks are excluded from the mandatory input set. The active lead-market-share preparation output is retained in the workflow trace despite having no later supplied consumer.

A byte-first safe reader was used for source evidence; datasheet lines 10-11 remain withheld, and log_file.smcl remains opaque. Quoted author path tokens are kept out of the assessment and represented only by the line/hash path map.

No author code, source data, regressions, model, install, download, network request, or executable startup was run. The one-row probes establish readable metadata/fields only; execution_verified remains false.
